name: Neemias Queta

name: Sam Merrill

name: Isaiah Joe

name: Kristaps Porzingis

name: Jimmy Butler III
comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Amen Thompson
comment: Thompson (knee) is out for Monday's game against the Heat.

name: Johnny Furphy

name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser

name: Austin Reaves

comment: Walker (leg) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Hornets.

name: GG Jackson
comment: Jackson will undergo surgery to repair the broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot and is set to miss significant time.

name: Richie Saunders
comment: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Nikola Jovic
comment: Jovic (illness) is out for Monday's game against Houston.

name: Pelle Larsson

name: Ryan Rollins

name: Thomas Sorber

name: Jonathan Isaac

name: Jaylen Brown

name: LeBron James
comment: James (back) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Nets.

name: Adem Bona

name: Ariel Hukporti

name: Mark Williams

name: Chris Youngblood

name: Vit Krejci

name: Ja Morant

While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

name: Maxime Raynaud

name: Felix Okpara

name: Tristan Vukcevic

name: Justin Champagnie

name: Jamir Watkins
